chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Camels are an honor for their owners."

key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about the status of owning camels?
ai.summary: This hadith states that camels are a source of honor and prestige for those who possess them. It reflects their social and economic value in the society addressed by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2486 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:
"Camels are a source of honor for their owners."
